svg: Decoder Architecture (GPT Style)Autoregressive Generation - Only sees PREVIOUS wordsDECODER STACKInput: Previous TokensToken + Position Embeddings"The cat sat" → predict "on"<text x="350" y="320" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;" text-anchor="middle">Decoder Layer 1Masked Self-Attention (causal)+ Feed-Forward + LayerNorm<text x="350" y="420" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;" text-anchor="middle">Decoder Layer 2Can only attend to previous positions<text x="350" y="525" style="font: 12px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;" text-anchor="middle">... (GPT-2: 12-48 layers)<text x="350" y="600" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;" text-anchor="middle">Final Decoder LayerRich contextual representations<text x="350" y="700" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold; fill: #388e3c;" text-anchor="middle">Output Head✓ Linear → Softmax✓ Predicts next token✓ Vocabulary: 50k tokens✓ Sample: greedy/top-k/nucleusGenerates one token at a time!KEY CHARACTERISTICSCausal (Masked) AttentionCan only see PREVIOUS tokens (left-to-right)Position 3 can attend to: 0, 1, 2 (not 4, 5, ...)Prevents "cheating" by looking ahead!<text x="25" y="5" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">Autoregressive GenerationGenerate text token-by-token sequentially:1. Input: "The" → Predict: "cat"2. Input: "The cat" → Predict: "sat"3. Input: "The cat sat" → Predict: "on"This is how ChatGPT generates responses!Pre-training: Language ModelingTask: Predict next word given previous wordsInput: "The cat sat on the"Target: "mat"Learns language patterns from massive text<text x="25" y="5" style="font: 13px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">Use Cases• Text generation (stories, articles)• Code completion (GitHub Copilot)• Chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude)• Translation (decoder part)Good for GENERATION, not bidirectional tasks📊 GPT MODEL SIZESGPT-2 (2019):Layers: 12-48, Params: 117M-1.5BGPT-3 (2020):Layers: 96, d_model: 12288, Heads: 96Parameters: 175 billionGPT-4 (~2023):Estimated: 1+ trillion parametersSame architecture, just MUCH bigger!GPT showed that decoder-only models can achieve amazing performance on almost any language task!
